title: RGI 7.0 glacier centerlines
description:
One row per centerline: the main centerline and the tributary centerlines of every glacier, with RGI's attributes, in one GeoParquet file. The web map archive holds the lines from z8.

This is an unofficial mirror, not endorsed by the RGI Consortium. The authoritative source is [RGI 7.0 at NSIDC](https://nsidc.org/data/nsidc-0770/versions/7). Citation and credit belong to the RGI Consortium:

> RGI 7.0 Consortium. (2023). *Randolph Glacier Inventory: A dataset of global glacier outlines* (Version 7.0) [Data set]. NSIDC: National Snow and Ice Data Center. https://doi.org/10.5067/F6JMOVY5NAVZ

providers.description: Produces the Randolph Glacier Inventory, a globally complete inventory of glacier outlines.

providers.name: Luis Q. Gentner
providers.description: Hosts this unofficial mirror. Converts the RGI files to cloud-native formats and maintains this catalog.

table:columns.name: rgi_id
table:columns.description: Unique identifier assigned to a single intersect line.

table:columns.name: rgi_g_id
table:columns.description: Glacier ID to which the centerline belongs.

table:columns.name: segment_id
table:columns.description: Integer number uniquely identifying this centerline within the glacier. The main centerline is always last.

table:columns.name: is_main
table:columns.description: Integer number indicating whether the centerline in the main centerline (1) or not (0). There is only one main centerline per glacier.

table:columns.name: outflow_id
table:columns.description: Each secondary centerline flows into another centerline. This identifier points to the `segment_id` to which this centerline flows to.

table:columns.name: strahler_n
table:columns.description: Strahler number (hydrological order) of the centerline, from lowest (1, line without tributaries but with possible descendants) to highest (the main centerline).

table:columns.name: length_m
table:columns.description: Length of the centerline in meters.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: The bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), the GeoParquet covering column. Readers use it to skip row groups in a spatial filter.

style-centerlines.title: Centerlines
style-centerlines.description: Glacier centerlines, the main centerline wider, from z8, over the glacier outlines.

thumbnail.title: Thumbnail
thumbnail.description: The default style of the data, drawn by chiitiler. The world views show the land of Natural Earth, which is in the public domain. The glacier products share one frame, the Garibaldi and Marinelli glaciers in the Cordillera Darwin, on white.
